# Selected Projects

analytical projects to which I have contributed.

<div class="portfolio-project-category">
SURVEY RESEARCH
</div>

<h2>HPV IMPACT</h2>

<p class="portfolio-project-summary">
A multi-country research initiative focused on improving methods for
measuring HPV vaccination coverage and equity among adolescent girls.
The project was implemented in Rwanda, Senegal, and Liberia.
</p>

<div class="portfolio-project-section">
<strong>My contributions</strong>

<p>
Survey methodology · Data management · Data quality monitoring ·
Statistical analysis · Scientific writing
</p>
</div>

<div class="portfolio-project-section">
<strong>Tools</strong>

<p>SurveyCTO · R · Stata</p>
</div>

<a href="https://aphrc.org/project/improving-methods-for-measuring-the-coverage-and-equity-of-human-papillomavirus-hpv-vaccination-in-gavi-priority-countries/"
target="_blank">
View project on APHRC →
</a>

:::

<div class="portfolio-project-category">
EPIDEMIOLOGICAL RESEARCH
</div>

<h2>KEMIS</h2>

<p class="portfolio-project-summary">
A multi-site serosurveillance initiative in Kenya that generated
evidence on SARS-CoV-2 and other pathogens through population-based
surveys and contributed to public health decision-making.
</p>

<div class="portfolio-project-section">
<strong>My contributions</strong>

<p>
Data analysis · Statistical analysis · Scientific writing ·
Manuscript development
</p>
</div>

<div class="portfolio-project-section">
<strong>Tools</strong>

<p>SurveyCTO · R · Stata</p>
</div>

<a href="https://microdataportal.aphrc.org/index.php/catalog/146"
target="_blank">
View project data & documentation on APHRC →
</a>

:::
